<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->
## Faust: Controls {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 90%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
  - ***GUI elements*** in Faust can be ordered and gathered into horizontal/vertical or tab *layouts*, using '**groups**' or a special **path syntax** in their names. 
  - ***MIDI support*** can be added to any Faust program, simply by adding **metadata** on the **GUI elements** that we want to control. 
:::
  - ***Open Sound Control*** (***OSC***) support follows the same *metadata* logic. ***OSC*** is a protocol for ***exchanging control data*** between *multimedia devices*, such as *synthesizers*, *DAWs*, *audio programming languages*, etc.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.js code-line-numbers="|" filename="faust/examples/controls/osc.dsp"}
{{< include /faust/examples/controls/osc.dsp >}}
```
{{< faust faust/examples/controls/osc.dsp >}}
:::

<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->
## Faust: Controls {auto-animate=true}
<!-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------- -->

:::: {.columns .faust-layout}
::: {.column width="50%" .add-space}
::: {style="font-size: 90%;"}
::: {style="opacity: 0.5"}
  - ***GUI elements*** in Faust can be ordered and gathered into horizontal/vertical or tab *layouts*, using '**groups**' or a special **path syntax** in their names. 
  - ***MIDI support*** can be added to any Faust program, simply by adding **metadata** on the **GUI elements** that we want to control. 
  - ***Open Sound Control*** (***OSC***) support follows the same *metadata* logic. ***OSC*** is a protocol for ***exchanging control data*** between *multimedia devices*, such as *synthesizers*, *DAWs*, *audio programming languages*, etc.
:::
  - Finally ***HTTP control*** can be enabled in the same way, which allows *remote-control of a Faust program* within a **browser interface**.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="44%"}
```{.js code-line-numbers="|" filename="faust/examples/controls/http.dsp"}
{{< include /faust/examples/controls/http.dsp >}}
```
{{< faust faust/examples/controls/http.dsp >}}
:::
